crossRefs.note: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.
A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’
The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”
“ ‘You shall not take vengeance, nor bear any grudge against the children of your people; but you shall love your…
Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says Yahweh: “Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.…
For if you thoroughly amend your ways and your doings, if you thoroughly execute justice between a man and his neighbor;
if you don’t oppress the foreigner, the fatherless, and the widow, and don’t shed innocent blood in this place, and…
and has not wronged any, but has restored to the debtor his pledge, has taken nothing by robbery, has given his bread…
he who hasn’t lent to them with interest, hasn’t taken any increase from them, who has withdrawn his hand from…
“But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all my statutes, and does that which is…
Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that Yahweh, the God of Armies, will be gracious…
He has shown you, O man, what is good. What does Yahweh require of you, but to act justly, to love mercy, and to walk…
Aren’t these the words which Yahweh proclaimed by the former prophets, when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity…
These are the things that you shall do: speak every man the truth with his neighbor. Execute the judgment of truth and…
and let none of you devise evil in your hearts against his neighbor, and love no false oath: for all these are things…
I will come near to you to judgment; and I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, and against the adulterers…
Jesus answered, “The greatest is, ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:
Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.
For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be…
For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”
but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith,
For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

translations.web: Therefore whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.
translations.bsb: In everything, then, do to others as you would have them do to you. For this is the essence of the Law and the Prophets.
translations.kjv: Therefore all things whatsoever ye would that men should do to you, do ye even so to them: for this is the law and the prophets.
translations.asv: All things therefore whatsoever ye would that men should do unto you, even so do ye also unto them: for this is the law and the prophets.
